about.h2: Built on Craft. Powered by Family.
about.p_html: Founder Germy Garcia comes from a long line of electricians. We deliver straight-shooting, code-compliant work with clear timelines and clean finishes.

licensed.p_html: CR-11 Residential Electrical (Arizona). ROC346957. We pull permits and meet code on every job.

bonded.p: Surety bond coverage adds financial protection. It’s an extra layer of accountability for your project.

insured.p: General liability and worker coverage. You’re protected if the unexpected happens.

contact.p: We’d love to hear about your project. Call or email us today!

service_area.p: Based in Maricopa, serving clients across Arizona.
